axes: reference-epoch heliocentric Galactic XYZ; screen Y = -Yg

coverageCatalog.note: Independent single-catalogue coverage avoids counting aliases from several catalogues as 100 distinct galaxies. Margin includes the self Milky Way entry and classification uncertainty; no spatial deduplication or membership is inferred.

pole: screen negative Y for Z >= 0; positive Y for Z < 0
notes: Radial placement applies to object anchors only. Declared members share their host translation and Galactic XY offsets; membership has priority over distance domains and members bypass individual radius/floor constraints. All extended shapes retain their local XY geometry. Unassociated anchors retain the fixed solar 1000 ly and Galactic-centre 15 million ly distance domains, local cartographic domains and CF4 group rules from v3. No new physical membership, fitting or science-coordinate changes. Frozen anchors v2 unchanged.
localGeometry: Galactic XY offsets (dx, -dy); identical in full and radial; Z is retained for physical slice clipping
